verses.text: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.

xrefs.text: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.

verses.text: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”

xrefs.text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
“Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

verses.text: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.

xrefs.text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.
“They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.

verses.text: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.

xrefs.text: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.
Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.

verses.text: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.

xrefs.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

verses.text: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.

xrefs.text: Then I said, ‘How I long to make you My sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of all the nations!’ I thought you would call Me ‘Father’ and never turn away from following Me.
He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.text: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.

xrefs.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

verses.text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

xrefs.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.

xrefs.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

verses.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

xrefs.text: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.

verses.text: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

xrefs.text: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
